Welcome to Discover Life Chiropractic where we help people finally understand why they hurt.

If you’ve been told:
“It’s just stress.”
“It’s normal headaches.”
“Your imaging looks fine.”
“You’ll just have to live with it.”

We’re here to dig deeper.

Dr. Dave is one of the only chiropractors in Pierce, King and Thurston County trained in advanced ligament stress X-ray analysis (SpineCAMP) and specializes in upper cervical and cranial-based care.

On this channel, you’ll find:

✔ Real explanations for chronic neck pain
✔ Migraine & headache education
✔ Car accident recovery guidance
✔ Home rehab & towel exercises
✔ Behind-the-scenes in our office
✔ Patient education that actually makes sense

Our goal is simple: help you heal smarter.

Subscribe and take control of your health.
